decisive_spans.text: Opacification on right frontal sinus, right ethmoid sinus, and right maxillary sinus and expansion of the right frontal sinus and right ethmoid sinus without any bone destruction

response.rationale: The vignette describes imaging findings of opacification and expansion of the right frontal sinus, which are key features of a mucocele. While frontal sinusitis (D4) also involves opacification, the expansion of the sinus is more indicative of a mucocele. The other candidates are less supported by the imaging findings.
